rule.text: On 1 March 2026 a line passed only if the total excess over the PO price was no more than the lower of 2% of the PO line value and ₹1,000 [1]. This rule was superseded on 1 April 2026, when SOP v4.0 lowered the limit to the lower of 1% and ₹500 [2].

citations.quote: Price variance is acceptable up to the lower of 2% of the line value and ₹1,000.
Where the invoice unit price is higher than the PO unit price, the line passes only if the total excess on that line is no more than the lower of 1% of the PO line value and ₹500.
